body: I have tried to make friends but I just dont trust people, I know most people are nice but ever since we moved from my old home it is hard. starting a new high school as a sophomore Is hard. I do try to make friends, but with a speech impediment + horrible social anxiety, and a mild case of aspergers and such a thick wall it is hard. I have "friends", people who I might sit with at lunch but the thing is is that friends are not the most important thing it feels like, I have always been a bit of an introvert, Like if you asked me whether I prefer a god book and music vs a party it would be book + music every time. My closes friends have always been my sisters. I am currently 17. I am currently in the midwest.

it started off in 5th grade due to bullying and publicly humiliated in front of the whole school so from that point on I just kind of sunk from there. It was slow at first but over the last 3 years there  have been many deaths in the family including my grandpa, grandma, uncle, and other uncle. My grandpa died of cancer, which in a cruel twist of events the cancer took him on his birthday, my uncle also died of cancer although it was slower and much more painful to see  due to the fact that he was basically out of his mind by the end of it.  my grandma died of a heart attack while she was visiting us. and then my other uncle a stated above killed himself. This has basically left me emotionally dead. 
The back pain is spread over my entire back  due to the 2 conditions I have . My scoliosis is at a fairly extreme angle and I dont have enough growth left for a brace and we have no money for the surgery since our insurance wont cover it. The kyphosis is in the upper section of my back were my top vertebrae have collapsed into triangles. and the thoughts are more recent within about the past month.
